attachments.origin_landmark: pterygoid fossa (deep head); tuberosity of maxilla (small superficial head)
attachments.insertion_landmark: medial surface of the ramus/angle of mandible

actions: elevates mandible, assists protrusion; with masseter forms a sling supporting the mandibular angle

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Runs roughly parallel to masseter but on the ramus's medial surface; together the two form a muscular sling cradling the angle of the mandible.
